section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study investigating the role of loneliness and gratitude as predictors of subjective well-being. The sample consisted of 219 participants, with 78.99% being women. Hierarchical regression analysis revealed that gratitude significantly predicted positive affect, loneliness in the family predicted negative affect, and social loneliness was the best predictor for life satisfaction.
